content:
We have applied three templates sequentially, got precursors at each step.

First step (template 324324) gave two products: product1? Actually apply_template returns list of tuples? It returned "(('Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)O)cc2)cc1', 'Nc1ccccc1N'),)". So precursors: a sulfonyl aryl with aldehyde? Actually first product is the target with O replaced? Wait original target: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1. After first template, we got "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)O)cc2)cc1" and "Nc1ccccc1N". So the amide side chain replaced by carboxylic acid? Actually the amide N-phenylamine removed.

Second template 1914396 applied to first precursor gave "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(C=O)cc2)cc1" and "O=C(O)CC(=O)O". So the side chain reduced to aldehyde and a dicarboxylic acid fragment.

Third template 733 applied to "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(C=O)cc2)cc1" yields something? We haven't applied yet. Need to apply to get further precursors. Let's apply template 733.
